module.Title: Add HAND-OFF-AUTO
module.Teaching: String comparisons can select an operating mode. Each mode can run different control logic.
module.PredictionQuestion: Which operator compares the selected mode?
module.PredictionExplanation: Two equals signs compare values without changing the variable.
module.DebugPrompt: Use == for both comparisons and include an else path for OFF.
module.RecallPrompt: Rebuild the HAND-OFF-AUTO mode selector. Use the exact identifier print. Use these exact values: "Automatic control", "Equipment off", "Manual run".
module.TransferPrompt: Create LOCAL and REMOTE modes with a fallback Disabled state. Use these exact identifiers: mode, print. Use these exact values: "Local control", "Remote control".
module.PreviewMessage: The facility now supports familiar equipment operating modes.
